messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey you,{01 00 00 05 00} are you into
espionage and spying and
all that?
When I have a spare second,
I try to study up on my
ninja skills, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
You know, like hunting down
people in the darkness.

I sneak right up behind 'em
and then scream
"I AM BEHIND YOU!"
{07 0b 00}Wanna try it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule sina,{01 00 00 05 00} kas sa oled
spionaaži ja luuramise ja
kõige selle lainel?
Kui mul on vaba hetk,
üritan ma oma ninja-
oskusi lihvida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Tead küll, näiteks inimeste
jahtimine pimeduses.

Ma hiilin neile selja taha
ja siis karjun:
„MA OLEN SINU SELJA TAGA!”
{07 0b 00}Tahad proovida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}All right, rookie.{01 00 00 05 00} What's the
first rule of surviving
a night patrol?
{07 19 00}Criminals never hide out in
the open. {01 00 00 05 00}Why?!
{01 00 00 05 00}'Cause that'd be STUPID!
{07 15 00}You gotta STAY ALERT and
find 'em before they find
you.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}Are you in, or what,
{04 1f 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hea küll, uustulnuk.{01 00 00 05 00} Mis on
öise patrulli ellujäämise
esimene reegel?
{07 19 00}Kurjategijad ei peitu
lagedal. {01 00 00 05 00}Miks?!
{01 00 00 05 00}Sest see oleks RUMAL!
{07 15 00}Sa pead olema VALVEL ja
leidma nad enne, kui nemad
leiavad sinu.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}Oled sa mängus või mis,
{04 1f 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Wanna play
{ff 00 00 02}cowboys and ninjas{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Of course, I'll be the ninja.
You can be the cowboy,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 06 00}Come on, I know you don't
have anything important
to do! {01 00 00 05 00}Are you in?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Mängime
{ff 00 00 02}kauboisid ja ninjasid{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Muidugi olen mina ninja.
Sina võid olla kauboi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 06 00}Ole nüüd, ma tean, et sul
pole midagi tähtsat
teha! {01 00 00 05 00}Oled mängus?
